text:
sasha: Quick heads-up — Ben and I will pair-deploy a small kernel + quant-profile tweak during the quiet window tonight at 01:30 UTC. planning ~15m, canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%.
ben: I can take deploy lead, sasha will handle rollback & smoke verification.
maria: I can run the embedding and chat smoke scripts and verify latency P50/P95 after canary hops.
aj: I will watch traces/alerts and keep the fastpath dashboard open. ping me if anything odd.
deploy-bot: Slot reserved by @ben for 2026-03-18T01:30:00Z (quiet-window). Token: slot-439.
ci-bot: Canary rollout initiated: kernel v1.14.2 + quant profile qv2. See /deploys/2169999999 for logs.
sasha: Short plan: 1) bump runtime image 2) enable quant qv2 3) start 5% canary for 10m 4) run smoke script 5) if ok -> 25% for 10m -> 100%. rollback if error >= 3% 5xx or latency regression >20% P95.
maria: Smoke checklist attached (I'll paste results):
- basic chat prompt (ok)
- embeddings sample (ok)
- kv-cache sanity (db hits unchanged)
- decode errors (none)

ben: Rollback command (if needed):
```
kubectl set image deploy/runtime runtime=registry.redwood.com/runtime:2026-03-04-rc3 --namespace=prod
kubectl rollout undo deployment/runtime --namespace=prod
```
ben: I'll also leave a quick tag: runtime:2026-03-18-canary-2169999999
aj: Telemetry checks I'll run: trace sample over last 5m, token cost delta, per-route P50/P95, error budget gauge. I'll post timestamps.
sasha: If infra-oncall needs to escalate, tag @infra-oncall and we'll pause immediately.
infra-oncall: ACK, monitoring channel open. I can assist with rollback or node remediation if GPU instances flake.
maria: Running first smoke now against 5% canary — posting results in 2m.
ci-bot: Canary progressed to 25% after 10m; health checks passing.
maria: 5% smoke: chat latency P95 280ms (baseline 260ms), embeddings unchanged. No 5xx. Marking as pass.
ben: Proceeding to 100% now. Will post final smoke.
sasha: After 100% completes, I'll trigger a quick synthetic run for 1k prompts to ensure steady-state.
aj: Noted — I'll watch for any drift in tokenization/regressions on the eval set.
maria: Final smoke at 100%: chat P95 300ms (up 15%), no errors. OK to close.
ben: Deploy closed. Tagging release notes and rollback instructions in the deploy ticket. :tada:
